list.title: Chat
list.empty: No chats yet. Start one with the pencil button.

home.title: Pick a chat
home.body: Open a chat from the list on the left or start a new one.

notFound.title: Chat not found
notFound.body: The chat was deleted or archived, or you are no longer a member.

header.spaceMembers: {space} space · {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}
header.alertSpace: {space} · alert chat · {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}
header.meeting: Meeting chat · {count, plural, one {# participant} other {# participants}}

pane.dropFiles: Drop files here to attach them

system.linked_space: {actor} linked the chat to a space
system.meeting_ended: Meeting ended · {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}
system.recording_ready: Meeting recording is ready · Drive › Meeting recordings

mention.title: People in this chat
mention.allHint: Notifies all {count} people in this chat
mention.confirmBody: This message notifies all {count} people in the chat, even those who muted it.

composer.offline: You are offline: what you write waits in line and is sent once connected.
composer.archived: This chat is archived; no new messages.
composer.readOnly: You cannot write in this chat.
composer.tooManyFiles: A message can carry at most {max} files.
composer.tooLong: A message can be at most {max} characters.

starter.direct: This chat is just the two of you. Files you share stay in Drive under Personal › Chat attachments.
starter.space: Everyone in the {space} space sees this chat. Attachments go to the space's Attachments folder.
starter.group: People added to the group see the history chosen when they were added.

files.emptyHint: Files shared in the chat show up here and in its Attachments folder in Drive.

pinned.emptyHint: Pick Pin from a message's menu to list it here.

new.title: New chat
new.goSpace: Go to the space chat · {count} members
new.pickHint: One person makes a direct chat, two or more make a group.
new.directSummary: Direct chat · opens the existing one if there is one
new.spaceSummary: Space chat: everyone who joins the space joins the chat too.
new.firstMessageHint: The chat is created with the first message and shows up in everyone's list.

rename.title: Rename chat
rename.name: Name
rename.hint: The name changes for everyone and a system line is posted. Without a name, members' names show.

add.title: Add people
add.subtitle: {name} · {count} members now

historyHints.none: They only see messages from when they are added.
historyHints.days7: Messages and files from the last week.
historyHints.days30: Messages and files from the last month.

add.systemLine: Adding posts a system line. An unnamed group's displayed name changes with the new member.

link.title: Link to a space
link.hint: The group becomes a space chat: membership comes from the space, history and attachments stay.
link.none: You are not an admin of any space.

leave.title: Leave {name}
leave.body: The chat leaves your list; you won't see its messages until added again.

delete.title: Delete message?
delete.body: The message is deleted for everyone and shows "This message was deleted".
delete.others: {name}'s message is deleted for everyone. You do this as a space admin.
delete.files: {count, plural, one {The attached file goes} other {The # attached files go}} to the Drive trash.

clear.title: Delete {name} for you?
clear.body: The chat leaves your list and its messages so far are hidden from you only; the others still see them. A new message brings the chat back, empty.

deleteAll.title: Delete {name} for everyone?
deleteAll.body: All messages and attachments are deleted for everyone; attachments go to the Drive trash and are removed for good when it expires. This cannot be undone and is written to the audit log.
deleteAll.confirm: Type the chat name to confirm

hooks.title: Apps and webhooks
hooks.hint: Apps that post into this chat from outside. Each webhook writes with its own secret URL.
hooks.regenerated: New URL created; the old one stopped working.
hooks.limitedHint: It went over {limit} requests a minute in the last hour; the rest got 429 and the app should retry after Retry-After.
hooks.failingHint: Recent requests were refused with 4xx. See the delivery log for the reason.
hooks.googleBody: Only change the webhook URL in the app. Google Chat's text and cardsV2 bodies are accepted as they are.
hooks.createHint: The webhook posts into {name} as a bot.
hooks.name: Name
hooks.nameHint: Shown as the bot name on messages.
hooks.urlHint: The secret key is part of the URL; this is the only time you see it in full.
hooks.limits: 60 requests a minute, body up to 32 KB. Anything over gets 429 or 413.
hooks.logHint: Requests of the last 7 days. Click a failed row for the reason and the relevant part of the body; the key is never stored.
hooks.logEmpty: No requests in the last 7 days.

codes.5xx: Error on our side; the app should retry

integrations.hint: Brings GitHub, Azure DevOps or Jira events into {name} as cards. The signature is checked on every request.
integrations.secretHint: Shown only now. Paste it into the service's webhook settings.

setup.github:
Repository › Settings › Webhooks › Add webhook.
Payload URL: the address above. Content type: application/json.
Secret: the secret. Events: "Let me select individual events" with the choices here.
setup.azure_devops:
Project settings › Service hooks › Web Hooks.
URL: the address above. Basic authentication: any user name, the secret as password.
Add one subscription per event type.
setup.jira:
Jira settings › System › WebHooks › Create a WebHook.
URL: the address above. Secret: the secret.
Events: Issue created/updated/deleted and Comment created.

event.pull_request: Pull request opened, merged, closed, review requested

search.placeholder: Search messages · from:name filters by person
search.startHint: Only chats you can read, and only the history shared with you.
search.noneHint: Try another word or remove filters.

empty.inbox: Mentions, shares and assignments show up here.
empty.snoozed: Nothing snoozed. Snoozed notifications come back unread at the time you pick.

status.title: Set your status

hints.busy: Notifications go quiet, messages stay unread
hints.dnd: Only calls and critical alerts come through
hints.invisible: You appear offline and keep using everything

status.autoMeetingHint: You show as Busy during calendar meetings and calls, and as Presenting (like do not disturb) while sharing your screen

durations.week: Until the end of this week

prefs.hint: Pick how you hear about each kind. Locked boxes cannot be turned off.
prefs.lockedNote: Locked boxes cannot be turned off, for security.
prefs.pageSubtitle: Turn the bell, desktop, phone and e-mail digest on or off for each kind of notification.

chat_reply.title: Replies

prefs.soundHint: Plays a short sound while you are in another chat or the tab is in the background. Mentions and direct messages sound brighter. Silent for muted chats, do not disturb and quiet hours. Saved in this browser.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.hint: Plugins you see. For those that can notify you, turn each channel on or off (e.g. WhatsApp only on the desktop, never on the phone). Saved to your account, on every device.

prefs.alertPlugins: Plugin notifications follow this row too; set each plugin in the Plugins section.

disabled.title: Chat is turned off in this organisation
disabled.body: An admin turned the chat module off. Your chats come back as they were when it is turned on.

admin.deleteForEveryoneHint: When on, group owners and org admins can delete a chat with its messages and attachments for everyone. Direct and space chats are never deleted for everyone.

commands.whisperDirect: No need to whisper in a one-to-one chat; it is already just the two of you.
